lakes.where: UPPER(LAKE) IN ('EAST TWIN LAKE','WEST TWIN LAKE','WASHINING LAKE','WASHINEE LAKE') OR UPPER(LAKE) LIKE '%WASHIN%' OR UPPER(NAMED_POLY) LIKE '%WASHIN%' OR UPPER(LAKE) LIKE '%EAST TWIN%' OR UPPER(LAKE) LIKE '%WEST TWIN%'
lakes.candidate_fields: OBJECTID; HYPOLY_COD; HYDRO_POLY; AV_LEGEND; NAMEDP_COD; NAMED_POLY; LAKE_NO; LAKE; ACREAGE; Shape__Area; Shape__Length
lakes.selection_notes: Approve exactly two polygons: East Twin/Washining and West Twin/Washinee. Preserve separation and verify total 859 acres.
